welcome.sub:
Fledge gives your Claude Code a graphical workbench: manage several projects, keep work and personal accounts apart, and run multiple sessions side by side.
Next we'll walk through your development environment and settings. Every step is optional — you can rerun any of them later from Settings.

roots.sub: Each root folder's immediate subfolders are scanned as projects.
roots.note: Your settings file is created when you finish this step. Everything after this is optional — close the window whenever you like and the root folders you added are kept. Pick up the rest from Settings.

env.sub: Install anything that's missing right here, then hit Re-check to refresh.
env.brewHint: The official installer is interactive and needs sudo — please run it in your own terminal.
env.pathHint: PATH and git identity: ~/.local/bin must be on your PATH (claude and uv install there); commits fail if git config --global user.name/user.email is unset. Neither is detected automatically in this version.

login.sub: Each account signs in separately — shared config files do not carry your login.
login.note: Fledge cannot confirm whether a sign-in succeeded: on macOS, Claude keeps its credentials in the Keychain rather than the account's config directory. All we do here is open a terminal with the right account environment — check its output to see how it went.
login.codexDesc: Codex signs in globally, not per account.

cc.sub: Let both accounts use one copy of commands, plugins, skills and settings instead of maintaining each side separately.
cc.ownerDesc: personal gets links pointing at work's matching items. CLAUDE.md stays a real file on both sides.
cc.yourOwn: you have your own version, contents differ
cc.conflictHint: CLAUDE.md is left untouched — setup only does things that can't overwrite your work. To replace it with work's version, open the Development environment section in Settings, where you can authorise each item individually (it renames a backup first).
cc.advHint: The advanced item projects (shared session history) is left alone by default.
cc.naDesc:
~/.claude-tc doesn't exist — you're using a single account, so there's nothing to share.
This card reappears once you add a second account in Settings.

sys.sub: All three are optional and can be changed any time in Settings.
sys.subsDesc: Used by the dashboard to work out net return (cost vs usage).
sys.kmsDesc: The memory panel reads library/ and topics/ under this folder as cross-project knowledge.
sys.tpl1: A CLAUDE.md and docs/ skeleton for a new project — generic, meant to be edited.
sys.deployHint: Never overwrites: existing files at the destination are always kept, only what's missing is added.

done.summary:
Found 20 projects
across 2 root folders and 2 accounts
done.hint: Anything you skipped — sign-in, templates — is waiting in the Development environment section of Settings.

st.title: Settings
st.stub: Root folders · Manual projects · Accounts · Knowledge base root (existing sections, not redrawn in this prototype)
st.ccDesc: work → personal. 1 item needs your authorisation.
st.backupHint: Ticked items are renamed to CLAUDE.md.fledge-backup-20260726-001 before the link is created — nothing is deleted outright.
st.rerunHint: Environment checks and sign-in are one-off steps — rerun setup whenever you need them.
